title: A Fin in the Pan
lines: Tim sat at a tin pan.
A fin is in the pan!
It is a fat tan fin.
Sam! Sis! A fin is in it!
Nip, nip! The fin is at Sis.
Fan it, Sam. Fan the fin.
Nap, fin! Nap in the tin.

questions.ask: What was in the tin pan?
questions.listenFor: A fin, which means a fish. It is said in the second line. If your child is stuck, point at that line rather than telling them.
Sis. You are listening for the name. If they say the girl, ask which one, and let them find the line that names her.

questions.ask: Do you think the fin liked the tin better than the pan? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: There is no wrong answer. Listen for a reason from the story, like the fin napped in the tin or it nipped when it was in the pan.
